focus: Drama and feud-driven week: lead with the biggest viral names (Wembanyama's huge Wednesday vs. Dallas, Luka's third straight 40-point game, the Embiid shoving match) and the trade-rumor storylines (Warriors/Draymond/Porzingis/Markkanen, Jokic/Nuggets, Norman Powell/Bulls). Every rumor is framed as a rumor and attributed to the outlet or reporter that broke it. Stories and exact facts come from each day's news; nothing is invented.

long_videos.title_idea: The Trade Rumor Board: Warriors, Nuggets, Bulls and Who Might Actually Move
long_videos.angle: Anchor video for the week, 8-10 min with chapters and a recap. 3-5 connected rumor stories drawn from the current headlines: Warriors and Draymond Green / Porzingis-for-Markkanen (include that one insider doubts it), Jokic and Denver trade chatter (note outlets that disagree), Norman Powell and the Bulls, and the 'most likely to be traded' lists. Every item is attributed ('per...', 'reportedly'), clearly labeled as rumor, and ends with a stakes line (standings, contract, deadline). Faceless: headline, quote and stat cards with the source on screen, no logos or player photos. Closes with a recap and a comment-bait question on which rumor is real.

long_videos.title_idea: Drama of the Week: Feuds, Flashpoints and Hot Takes Around the NBA
long_videos.angle: Weekend-facing recap of the week's biggest conflicts and viral moments, 8-10 min with chapters: Embiid's technical after the shoving match, the Bronny James diss and fan backlash, Charles Barkley's Halloween rant, Rich Paul vs. Max Kellerman, and Wembanyama/Luka standout performances. Pick the 3-5 with the most heat by Friday, give each a scene-first open, the detail most people missed, the stakes, and her one clear opinion. Only sourced facts and quotes. End with a recap and a vote-style question.

shorts_themes: Viral performance of the day: the biggest stat-line story (Wembanyama, Luka's 40-point streak) told as a scene with the specific detail people missed
Trade rumor of the day: one attributed rumor, what it would change for the standings or contract, her take, and a 'real or fake?' question
Feud or drama of the day: Embiid, Bronny/LeBron discourse, Barkley, Rich Paul vs. Kellerman, told as a story with a clear opinion
Injury or lineup news that changes a race: only confirmed reports, framed with stakes
Team under pressure: one-line diagnosis from sourced reporting (e.g., Cavs' reliance on Harden after the loss to the Thunder)
Rookie or new-arrival watch: debut and breakout moments (e.g., Knecht's Knicks debut), what it means for the rotation
series: Rumor or Reality: one trade rumor per Short, attributed source, her verdict
The Detail You Missed: a film-room style single-detail breakdown
Hot Take Court: one polarizing story, her ruling, viewers argue in comments
experiments: Test question-style hooks vs. number-first hooks in the first sentence across Shorts and compare retention at the 2-second and 10-second marks
Test whether 'Rumor or Reality' titled Shorts get more comments than standard news Shorts
Test a Tuesday vs. Thursday upload slot for the anchor long video, then check the channel's own analytics before locking the day
Test a feud-led vs. trade-led opening chapter in the long videos and compare early drop-off
